selection_experiment.interpretation: Selection-policy comparison, not inverted probabilities. Returns are theoretical before execution, commission and slippage. Samples across streams may share events; do not sum them as independent proof.

factors.interpretation: High odds imply lower expected hit rates. Market-implied expected wins are descriptive; repeated events/markets are correlated, so a naive binomial test across positions is invalid.
